title: S3 ACC Platform Roles and Permission Boundaries

entries.name: Information Manager
entries.boundary: Overall CDE architecture, information security, archive write-lock enforcement, contractual submission validation.

entries.name: Project BIM Manager
entries.boundary: Operational coordination governance, Gate E sign-off, model promotion and /02 administration.

entries.name: CDE Manager
entries.boundary: Technical provisioning, onboarding, group assignment, permission audits, and platform configuration.

entries.name: Project BIM Coordinator
entries.boundary: Coordination spaces, issue creation/assignment, clash verification.

entries.name: Discipline Lead
entries.boundary: Own-discipline WIP administration and controlled package sharing.

entries.name: Main Contractor Representative
entries.boundary: Published consumption plus submittal/RFI interfaces per BEP.

entries.name: Client Representative
entries.boundary: Published/transmittal review and record access per BEP.

provenance.migration_note: Three distinct governed functions retain Project Administrator capability. Capability overlap is preserved and does not imply role equivalence. Programmatic separation of privileges remains under curator review.
